nodes.label: Config Loader
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the complete configuration loading pipeline with hybrid staleness detection (timestamps + content hashes).

nodes.label: Loader::load
nodes.rationale: Entry point for configuration loading; handles discovery, ingestion, staleness detection, merging, and persistence.

nodes.label: Validated Paths
nodes.rationale: Ensures filesystem locations are vault-relative and protected against traversal escapes.

nodes.label: Schema Config Spec
nodes.rationale: Minimal, filesystem-focused view for the discovery engine to avoid full config coupling.

nodes.label: Raw Config
nodes.rationale: DTO for deserializing and merging TOML/JSON/YAML configuration layers before validation.

nodes.label: Raw Config Metadata
nodes.rationale: Stores timestamps and BLAKE3 hashes for staleness detection.

nodes.label: Repository Trait
nodes.rationale: Unified repository pattern combining read and write operations for configuration persistence.

nodes.label: Redb Storage
nodes.rationale: Production storage backend using the redb embedded database with zero-copy optimized reads.

nodes.label: Task Config
nodes.rationale: Defines how Markdown tasks are recognized, parsed, and indexed.

nodes.label: Field Spec
nodes.rationale: Type-driven validation for custom metadata fields (Integer, Float, String, Enum, DateTime).

nodes.label: Vault Config
nodes.rationale: Vault-specific settings and overrides for global defaults.

nodes.label: Vault ID
nodes.rationale: Unique identity for vaults using time-ordered UUID v7.

nodes.label: Vault Root
nodes.rationale: Validated absolute path representing the sandbox boundary for vault operations.

nodes.label: Global Config View
nodes.rationale: Maintains a ring buffer of recent global config states for history tracking and rollback.

nodes.label: Vault Config View
nodes.rationale: Maintains a ring buffer of recent vault config states.

nodes.label: DB Context
nodes.rationale: Provides persistence infrastructure for rebuildable domain projections.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.rationale: Concrete wrapper for redb providing zero-copy read/write primitives.

nodes.label: Retry Logic
nodes.rationale: Exponential backoff retry strategy for transient database errors (locks, I/O).

nodes.label: FS Context
nodes.rationale: Provides safe file discovery, read, and write capabilities scoped to vault roots.

nodes.label: Relative Path
nodes.rationale: Type-safe wrapper ensuring paths do not escape vault roots.

nodes.label: FS Reader
nodes.rationale: Root-scoped filesystem adapter with built-in validation and format classification.

nodes.label: DirScanner
nodes.rationale: Standalone directory scanner utility for finding files matching criteria; not embedded in Reader to allow reuse across contexts.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.rationale: Security foundation for all file-based adapters, preventing path traversal, symlink escape, and unauthorized access to hidden files.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.rationale: Provides safe file writes with atomic replace semantics using temporary files to prevent data corruption.

nodes.label: Graph
nodes.rationale: Pure infrastructure for directed graphs; handles raw structure and adjacency without serialization constraints.

nodes.label: DagGraph
nodes.rationale: Validated DAG wrapper that caches topological order and roots for efficient traversal and hierarchy resolution.

nodes.label: Note (Concept)
nodes.rationale: A single vault document represented as domain state; vault files are the source of truth.

nodes.label: Frontmatter (Concept)
nodes.rationale: Structured metadata block at the beginning of a note used for schema-based validation and discovery.

nodes.label: Task (Concept)
nodes.rationale: Checklist item extracted from note content; distinct from structural list items.

nodes.label: Note
nodes.rationale: Aggregate root consolidating all extracted facts about a markdown file; optimized for storage density and zero-copy access.

nodes.label: NoteId
nodes.rationale: Stable identifier using UUID v7 for time-ordered efficiency in database indexing.

nodes.label: NoteError
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical umbrella error type for the Note domain, preserving context across the ingestion pipeline.

nodes.label: NoteEvent
nodes.rationale: Audit record for note lifecycle changes, supporting incremental indexing and event-driven updates.

nodes.label: Frontmatter
nodes.rationale: Type-safe API for accessing YAML/TOML metadata while handling unquoted WikiLinks and Obsidian-specific nuances.

nodes.label: InlineField
nodes.rationale: Metadata fields embedded in markdown text (key:: value), allowing structured data attachment to any content.

nodes.label: Link
nodes.rationale: Models wiki-links and markdown links with anchor and alias support for rich document relationships.

nodes.label: ListItem
nodes.rationale: Represents the physical presence of a bullet in the source file, capturing structural nesting and list semantics.

nodes.label: RawAssembler
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the conversion from parser IR (DocTree/Events) to raw domain artifacts (RawNote).

nodes.label: Block (AST Node)
nodes.rationale: Uses type-state pattern (Open/Closed) to ensure structural integrity and prevent reading unfinalized content.

nodes.label: EventStreamConfig
nodes.rationale: Data-driven policy for parser behavior, decoupling parsing logic from extension and normalization rules.

nodes.label: ParserContext
nodes.rationale: Enables zero-cost multi-pass processing by caching expensive pulldown-cmark events and reference definitions.

nodes.label: ArtifactLexer
nodes.rationale: Scans derived text sequences for domain artifacts (tags, fields) using configurable scan policies.

nodes.label: MarkdownParser
nodes.rationale: Primary entry point orchestrating the multi-stage ingestion pipeline.

nodes.label: ReferenceDefinitions
nodes.rationale: Normalizes and caches CommonMark link references for O(1) resolution during event stream iteration.

nodes.label: MarkdownEventStream
nodes.rationale: Facade adapter wrapping pulldown-cmark to provide a normalized, Lithos-specific IR event stream.

nodes.label: DocTree (AST)
nodes.rationale: Converts linear event streams into hierarchical block structures, enforcing CommonMark nesting rules.

nodes.label: TextSequence
nodes.rationale: Projects raw IR events into stable text nodes with style and context flags for consistent artifact scanning.

nodes.label: RangedEvent
nodes.rationale: Neutral parser IR carrying source byte ranges for error reporting and diagnostics.

nodes.label: NotePath
nodes.rationale: Value object enforcing Obsidian-compatible vault-relative path validation.

nodes.label: SourceByteRange
nodes.rationale: Primitive for tracking text spans within UTF-8 source files.

nodes.label: NoteProcessor
nodes.rationale: Typestate-driven pipeline (Discovery -> Analysis -> Construction) ensuring correct ingestion ordering.

nodes.label: RawNote
nodes.rationale: Unvalidated dual-write accumulator for all artifacts extracted during note ingestion.

nodes.label: RawSectionKind
nodes.rationale: Represents raw section kinds derived from AST nodes for early-stage document parsing.

nodes.label: RawFieldValue
nodes.rationale: Supports heuristic type detection during ingestion for inline fields and frontmatter to avoid redundant parsing.

nodes.label: Note Repository Trait
nodes.rationale: Unified repository trait combining read and write operations for the note context, following the File -> Raw -> Domain -> Storage pipeline.

nodes.label: Section
nodes.rationale: Represents a top-level section within a note, derived from root-level markdown blocks.

nodes.label: Tag
nodes.rationale: Value object representing hierarchical tags used for note organization.

nodes.label: Task
nodes.rationale: A semantic task entity promoted from a checkbox list item.

nodes.label: FieldValue
nodes.rationale: Shared primitive for dynamic note values in both frontmatter and task metadata.

nodes.label: ListView
nodes.rationale: Persistable projection optimized for common LSP and UI query patterns like position-based lookup via binary search.

nodes.label: Schema Context
nodes.rationale: Defines metadata/property rules and resolves references into validated schema-domain state.

nodes.label: Schema Aggregate
nodes.rationale: Main domain aggregate representing a fully resolved schema with all properties merged from parents.

nodes.label: PropertyBank
nodes.rationale: Singleton registry of reusable property definitions to ensure consistent ref-expansion and deterministic resolution.

nodes.label: Schema Builder
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates the full schema ingestion pipeline including discovery, property bank loading, and schema processing.

nodes.label: DiscoveryEngine
nodes.rationale: Performs a single atomic scan of both filesystem and database to ensure consistency and performance.

nodes.label: RefExpander
nodes.rationale: Resolves raw  property pointers against the PropertyBank so that the bank is no longer needed later in the pipeline.

nodes.label: SchemaId
nodes.rationale: UUID v7-based identifier separated from aggregates for cleaner dependency management.

nodes.label: SchemaName
nodes.rationale: Validated value object enforcing naming invariants for schemas.
